ImageDescription.value: M/S Suomenlinna II (ship, 2004), a Finnish car and passenger ferry, operating local traffic between Sveaborg and the Market Square in Helsinki, Finland. In the background, on the left, the isle of Valkosaari (Swedishː Blekholmen), with the club house of Nyländska Jaktklubben, the largest and the second oldest yacht club of Finland, founded in 1861, with the approval of its constitution by Tsar Alexander II.  Behind Valkosaari the isle of Luoto (Swedishː Klippan), with an Art Nouveau style villa, built in 1898, where the summer restaurant Saaristo operated for fifteen years, including the summer 2024. On the right, part of the district of Kaivopuisto (Swedishː Brunnsparken).
